external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Clipper is best known for the Liberty 2.5MW Wind Turbine, developed under a partnership with the Department of Energy’s National Renewable Energy Laboratory and manufactured at our plant in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. When the first units were installed in 2007, they were the largest turbines being manufactured in the United State. The Liberty contains four smaller generators instead of the typical single generator, significantly increasing its power generation capacity.

In 2024, Clipper was acquired by Longroad Energy. Based in Boston, Longroad has more than 20 years of experience in the renewable market, with a focus on developing, owning, and managing wind, solar, and storage projects throughout North America.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: The 360,000-square-foot plant in Cedar Rapids that Clipper now occupies began as a manufacturing facility for cable cranes and excavators, served as a warehouse space for Maytag appliances, and later was used to manufacture newspaper printing presses. With its vast laydown space, heavy steel inner structure, and bays with up to 50-ton overhead lift capacity, it proved the ideal choice for building our turbines.
